text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British police suspect Maltese connection in stolen car gang. Car thieves in Manchester, England are believed to be selling parts of stolen cars in Malta.

- Gaddafi warns there can be no Mediterranean peace without Libya. The Libyan leader, quoted by JANA news agency, blamed the EU for Libya's exclusion from the Euro-Med conference, held in Malta last month.
- Conservation society alarmed about prime minister's attacks on the Planning Authority. Prime Minister Alfred Sant has criticised the authority saying it hinders development.
- Police arrest 25-year-old man suspected of robbing 85 old woman.
